table.retrieve:
SELECT 	A.itemname,
			customer=(select name from accounts where accounts.acccode=:ar_custcode),
			saleday1=sum(A.saleday1),
			saleday2=sum(A.saleday2),
			saleday3=sum(A.saleday3),
			saleday4=sum(A.saleday4),
			saleday5=sum(A.saleday5), 
			saleday6=sum(A.saleday6),
			saleday7=sum(A.saleday7),
			saleday8=sum(A.saleday8),
			saleday9=sum(A.saleday9),
			saleday10=sum(A.saleday10),
			saleday11=sum(A.saleday11),
			saleday12=sum(A.saleday12),
			saleday13=sum(A.saleday13),
			saleday14=sum(A.saleday14),
			saleday15=sum(A.saleday15),
			saleday16=sum(A.saleday16),
			saleday17=sum(A.saleday17),
			saleday18=sum(A.saleday18),
			saleday19=sum(A.saleday19),
			saleday20=sum(A.saleday20)
 FROM

		(

					select 	dayno=datepart(day,SL.date),
					icode=SD.icode,
					itemname=max(I.name),
					saleday1=(case datepart(day,SL.date) when datepart(day, :ar_startdate) then sum(SD.looseqty) else 0 end),
					saleday2=(case datepart(day,SL.date) when datepart(day, :ar_startdate)+1 then sum(SD.looseqty) else 0 end),
					saleday3=(case datepart(day,SL.date) when datepart(day, :ar_startdate)+2 then sum(SD.looseqty) else 0 end),
					saleday4=(case datepart(day,SL.date) when datepart(day, :ar_startdate)+3 then sum(SD.looseqty) else 0 end),
					saleday5=(case datepart(day,SL.date) when datepart(day, :ar_startdate)+4 then sum(SD.looseqty) else 0 end),
					saleday6=(case datepart(day,SL.date) when datepart(day, :ar_startdate)+5 then sum(SD.looseqty) else 0 end),
					saleday7=(case datepart(day,SL.date) when datepart(day, :ar_startdate)+6 then sum(SD.looseqty) else 0 end),
					saleday8=(case datepart(day,SL.date) when datepart(day, :ar_startdate)+7 then sum(SD.looseqty) else 0 end),
					saleday9=(case datepart(day,SL.date) when datepart(day, :ar_startdate)+8 then sum(SD.looseqty) else 0 end),
					saleday10=(case datepart(day,SL.date) when datepart(day,:ar_startdate)+9 then sum(SD.looseqty) else 0 end),
					saleday11=(case datepart(day,SL.date) when datepart(day,:ar_startdate)+10 then sum(SD.looseqty) else 0 end),
					saleday12=(case datepart(day,SL.date) when datepart(day,:ar_startdate)+11 then sum(SD.looseqty) else 0 end),
					saleday13=(case datepart(day,SL.date) when datepart(day,:ar_startdate)+12 then sum(SD.looseqty) else 0 end),
					saleday14=(case datepart(day,SL.date) when datepart(day,:ar_startdate)+13 then sum(SD.looseqty) else 0 end),
					saleday15=(case datepart(day,SL.date) when datepart(day,:ar_startdate)+14 then sum(SD.looseqty) else 0 end),
					saleday16=(case datepart(day,SL.date) when datepart(day,:ar_startdate)+15 then sum(SD.looseqty) else 0 end),
					saleday17=(case datepart(day,SL.date) when datepart(day,:ar_startdate)+16 then sum(SD.looseqty) else 0 end),
					saleday18=(case datepart(day,SL.date) when datepart(day,:ar_startdate)+17 then sum(SD.looseqty) else 0 end),
					saleday19=(case datepart(day,SL.date) when datepart(day,:ar_startdate)+18 then sum(SD.looseqty) else 0 end),
					saleday20=(case datepart(day,SL.date) when datepart(day,:ar_startdate)+19 then sum(SD.looseqty) else 0 end)
				
				
				from 		saleledger SL, saledetail SD, Item I
				where 	SL.date between  :ar_startdate AND DATEADD ( d, 20, :ar_startdate )  AND
							SL.custcode=:ar_custcode AND
							SL.saleinvcode=SD.saleinvcode and
							SD.icode=I.icode
				
				group by	SD.icode, 
							datepart(day,SL.date)
							) AS A

GROUP BY A.itemname
ORDER BY A.itemname

objects.name: compute_4
objects.expression: saleday1 + saleday2  +  saleday3 +  saleday4 +  saleday5 +  saleday6 +  saleday7 +  saleday8 +  saleday9 +  saleday10 +  saleday11 +  saleday12 +  saleday13 +  saleday14 +  saleday15 +  saleday16 +  saleday17 +  saleday18 +  saleday19 +  saleday20
